description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines underscore templating functions, initializes Google Analytics, and includes functions for fetching files and issues, as well as a Learn class for dynamic content insertion related to the TodoMVC project.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for dynamically inserting project-related information and issue counts into the webpage.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Inserts a templated aside element into the document body, with options for backend or demo links.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches and displays the number of open issues from GitHub for the project.
